headline: Wardens Reclaim Expanse Outposts as Mooring County Battle Rages
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, Warden forces across Weathered Expanse have reclaimed ground from no-man's-land, pushing their standing to four strongholds against three Colonial positions and two ruined wastes amid nearly sixteen hundred fresh casualties in two hours. Severe fighting continues to grip Mooring County, where six fresh base clashes and roughly fifteen hundred fallen soldiers left the sector split between seven Warden outposts, four Colonial holdings, and one leveled redoubt. To the north, Pari Peak erupted into sudden action as Little Raakkua traded hands before Wardens reasserted full control across all five local installations. Along Stlican Shelf, Wardens managed to claim a second foothold near Breaker Town, clearing the hex of neutral ground while Colonials maintain seven fortified centers. Meanwhile, severe artillery and trench attrition persist without territorial shift in Dead Lands and along the Nevish Line, contrasting with cooling guns across Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy.
